description: Post-commit push required integrating 3 remote commits (scheduled harper content-discovery runs). `git pull --rebase --autostash` stalled twice on the OneDrive-synced repo: first, working-tree writes landing mid-rebase (live harness hooks and/or cross-machine OneDrive sync of the working tree) dirtied the exact files the pick needed to update; second, after resolving the single real conflict (skill-runs/git-latest.json, resolved to ours per David) and staging it cleanly (stage 0, no unmerged entries, no locks), `git rebase --continue` repeatedly refused with 'You must edit all merge conflicts', consistent with .git state being synced under git. Mid-rebase recovery also required raw git (the ies-git wrapper was absent from the mid-rebase tree because it was created in the unapplied commit, and an untracked live-written git-ops.jsonl blocked the first abort until moved aside). Rebase aborted cleanly; f3991afb intact; David chose to pull and push from his own terminal.
correction: Multi-commit integration (pull --rebase, merges, pushes after divergence) on this OneDrive-synced repo belongs in David's terminal, where no harness hooks or cross-machine sync races interfere. Single-operation wrapper commits remain fine from agent sessions.
systemic_fix: Proposed: add a rule to skills/git/SKILL.md that on divergence (remote ahead), the agent commits locally and hands pull/push to David's terminal instead of rebasing from the session; optionally extend the ies-git wrapper to recognize a blocked rebase state and abort with that guidance instead of leaving a mid-rebase tree.
